basic_info.description: Views! Views! Views! This stunning 1BR/1BA showcases spectacular Alcatraz, Golden Gate Bridge, and Marin Headlands panoramas through dramatic floor-to-ceiling sliding doors. Watch fog dance across sparkling bay waters daily. Located in Fontana Towers East, the City's most prestigious mid-century doorman building, this gorgeous home features an open kitchen/living/dining room with incredible views, plus custom cabinets with a maritime theme, a large bright bedroom with dazzling city lights views, & large bathroom & good closet space. Amenities:  24-hour doorman/security, secure underground parking, private storage, bike storage, guest parking, laundry facilities, enchanting Zen garden with BBQ & club room for entertaining. Amazing prime location: steps to Fort Mason Farmer's Market, Aquatic Park, Ghirardelli Square, vibrant Polk/Union/Chestnut dining & shopping. Join South End Rowing or Dolphin Club for fun & adventure! This rare architectural gem features San Francisco's mesmerizing maritime theater outside your windows.  All-inclusive HOA includes water, electricity, heat, cable, doorman, security, management, maintenance, insurance & reserves. Conveniences abound with its 93 WalkScore ("Walkers Paradise"). Your front-row seat to San Francisco magic awaits - don't miss!
